career_overview.short_description: Understand how devices connect and exchange information. Build, inspect and troubleshoot small networks using simulations and permitted test setups.
responsibilities: Assess goals and constraints relevant to network engineer work
Apply appropriate tools and methods to a bounded task
representative_work: A simulated network with an addressing plan and test evidence.

roadmap.title: Network Engineer: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor and browser. Most tasks use free software or simulation; specialist equipment, accounts and costs are flagged for review when applicable.
roadmap.final_outcome: A simulated network with an addressing plan and test evidence.
